The `median` in `score3.js` had an off-by-one bug: `return s[m] + 1;` added 1 to the middle element, so `median([1, 2, 3])` returned `3` instead of `2`. **Fix:** Removed the `+ 1` and also handled even-length arrays by averaging the two middle elements (standard median definition): ```js export function median(nums) { const s = [...nums].sort((a, b) => a - b); const m = Math.floor(s.length / 2); return s.length % 2 ? s[m] : (s[m - 1] + s[m]) / 2; } ``` **Re-run:** 1 test, 1 passed, 0 failed. ✔
